steps.instruction: Pay the cheapest flight CO357 fare (484.05 USD, lowest of CO357 484.05, ME875 491.81, SK576 1339.63) to billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'.
Pay The Linden nightly rate 109.41 x 7 nights = 765.87 USD to billing account ACCT-TLX-5470 with memo 'hotel booking'. The Linden is cheapest (Harbor View Inn 192.40, Atlas Suites 282.00).
Set KV key trip/total to 1249.92 (flight 484.05 + hotel 765.87) formatted with 2 decimals.
